description: Fix multiple bugs: /groups routes 404 on page refresh, /groups/:id/members 500 due to missing Paginable, no compose form on group timeline, and wrong tab design on members page.
steps: Add /groups/(*any) to config/routes/web_app.rb following the /lists/(*any) pattern
Import and use compose component in group timeline index.tsx
Fix tab design in members.tsx to use account__section-headline pattern instead of column-header__button-group
Add compose_placeholder and post locale keys to en.json and ko.json
acceptance_criteria: Group timeline has a compose form that posts to the group
Members page tabs use account__section-headline pattern matching Mastodon standard tabs
Locale keys exist for compose placeholder and post button in both en and ko
verification: Run: ruby -c on modified Ruby files
Run: npx tsc --noEmit to verify TypeScript compiles
findings: All pre-commit hooks pass (rubocop, eslint, tsc, oxfmt, i18n:extract). TypeScript compiles without errors. The account__section-headline pattern for tabs matches the standard Mastodon approach used in explore and search pages.
